manifest.guard_scope: tracks push_back, pop_front, size PLT calls nested within the three exported frequency functions; exact deque pointer
limitations: deque method wrapper overlap does not prove simultaneous memory instructions; instrumentation changes timing and misses inline/direct/iterator accesses
open-loop command sequence; no truth used online
header ABI and source-to-subscriber pairing require verification
Only push_back, pop_front and size calls dynamically bound through the probe inside three frequency functions are counted.
Exact object address identifies the same object in one process, not topic identity or cross-process equivalence.
Instrumentation extends wrapper intervals and changes scheduling; overlapping wrappers do not prove overlapping memory instructions.
Inline operations, iterator dereferences and other call paths are not covered; snapshots are lower bounds and short conflicts can be missed.
The option called frequency-guard loads this non-serializing development probe; it is not a fix.
